title: Beef kofta with yoghurt, bulgur and cucumber salad
steps: Grate the onion very finely, chop the parsley and knead with the mince, garlic, spices and salt, then shape into 8 long kofta.
Pour 200 ml hot salted water over the bulgur and leave for 10 minutes.
Cook the kofta in the oil in a griddle pan for 8–10 minutes, turning.
Dice the cucumber and tomato and mix with mint and lemon juice.
Serve the kofta with bulgur, salad and yoghurt.
